entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah, agent ID 303. How can I help you today?
Hi... um, Sarah. I need to return something. I have this VeloBand GPS Tracker, and I'm just... I'm so confused about how to do it. The website was a lot.
I can definitely help you with that. Just to be clear, what specifically is the issue? Are you experiencing a technical fault with the band, or is it more of a preference issue?

Oh, no, it works fine. I just... I think I **changed my mind**. It was a total **impulse buy**, to be honest, and I really **don't use it** at all. I feel a bit overwhelmed by it all. The policy online wasn't clear... can't you just help me?
Of course. It happens to all of us. Let me just pull up your account and take a look at the policy for you. Can I get the email address you used for the order?
Thank you. One moment... Okay, I see the order here for the VeloBand GPS Tracker, delivered 18 days ago on January 7th. Let me just double-check our return eligibility...
Okay, perfect. According to our policy, you're well within the 90-day return window. We can absolutely process a full refund for you.
Oh, thank goodness! I was so worried I was stuck with it. Are you sure that's okay?

Yes, absolutely. I see here that you're a VIP customer with us, so I've gone ahead and processed everything on my end. I've just sent a pre-paid return label to your email. All you need to do is put the band back in its original packaging, stick that label on the box, and you can drop it off at any post office.
Wow, that's... that's so easy. Thank you so much, Sarah.
You're very welcome. Once our warehouse receives the item, your refund will be processed back to your original payment method within 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can assist with?
No, that's everything. You've been a huge help.
Glad I could help. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great rest of your day.
